parameters.jsCode:
// DEMO MODE: stands in for the googleSheets node "Google Sheets Append" in workflow.json.
return { json: {
    "Timestamp": (new Date().toISOString()),
    "Source Email": ($('detectFileType').item.json.sender_email || 'unknown@example.com'),
    "Attachment Filename": ($('detectFileType').item.json.pdf_filename || 'N/A'),
    "Invoice Number": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.invoice_number),
    "Invoice Date": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.invoice_date),
    "Due Date": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.due_date),
    "Vendor Name": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.vendor_name),
    "Vendor Address": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.vendor_address),
    "Vendor Email": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.vendor_email),
    "Client Name": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.client_name),
    "Subtotal": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.subtotal),
    "Tax Amount": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.tax_amount),
    "Total": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.total),
    "Currency": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.currency),
    "Raw Response": ($('determineStatus').item.json.extracted_data?.raw_response || ($('detectFileType').item.json.fileType === 'unknown' ? 'UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE' : 'EXTRACTION_FAILED')),
    "Status": ($('determineStatus').item.json.status),
    "Status Color": ($('determineStatus').item.json.statusColor),
    "Avg Confidence": ($('determineStatus').item.json.avgConfidence),
    "Low Confidence Fields": ($('determineStatus').item.json.lowConfidenceFields && $('determineStatus').item.json.lowConfidenceFields.length > 0 ? $('determineStatus').item.json.lowConfidenceFields.map(f => f.field + ' (' + f.confidence + '%)').join(', ') : 'None'),
    "Math Discrepancies": ($('determineStatus').item.json.mathDiscrepancies && $('determineStatus').item.json.mathDiscrepancies.length > 0 ? $('determineStatus').item.json.mathDiscrepancies.join(', ') : 'None'),
    "Flags": ($('determineStatus').item.json.flags && $('determineStatus').item.json.flags.length > 0 ? $('determineStatus').item.json.flags.join(', ') : 'None'),
  } };
